title: Jd4
text:
Key Responsibilities

Develop new userfacing features using React.js and related technologies.
Build reusable components and frontend libraries for future use.
Optimize application performance, ensuring responsiveness on different devices and browsers.
Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into highquality code.
Work with REST APIs/GraphQL to integrate front end with backend services.
Collaborate with designers, backend developers, QA, and product teams.
Write clean, maintainable, and welldocumented code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.
Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript (preferred).
Solid understanding of React.js, including hooks, state management, lifecycle, and component patterns.
Experience with React ecosystem tools such as:
Redux / Zustand / Context API
React Router
Axios / Fetch API
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Styled Components, or other styling frameworks.
Experience with version control (Git).
Familiarity with build tools: Webpack, Vite, Babel, or similar.
Understanding of responsive and adaptive design principles.

title: Jd6
text:
Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain a web-based frontend application/plugin for ECU gateway configuration.
Integrate and consume data through OData and REST APIs.
Design and implement user-friendly interfaces for complex engineering workflows.
Build advanced UI capabilities such as drag-and-drop functionality, visual mapping, dynamic editors, and configuration views.
Collaborate closely with UX designers, backend developers, and system engineering teams.
Ensure high-quality, scalable, and maintainable front-end solutions.

Required Skills

4 - 8 years of experience in front-end development.
Strong expertise in Angular, React, or Vue.js.
Good understanding of modern Frontend architecture and best practices.
Experience working with REST APIs and/or OData services.
Hands-on experience building complex and interactive user interfaces.
Strong UI/UX design and usability understanding.
Ability to work independently in a collaborative Agile environment.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, FlexRay, or Automotive Ethernet.
Experience with engineering, configuration, or visualization tools.
Exposure to plugin-based architectures.
Understanding automotive software systems is a plus.
